meta.title: فرض الفصل الأول في اللغة الإنجليزية (النموذج 2)
topics: the past simple: regular and irregular verbs

paper:
Lalla Fatma N'Soumer was born in 1830 in a village near Ain El Hammam, in Kabylia. She learnt the Quran when she was very young and became famous for her wisdom. When the French army attacked Kabylia, she organised the resistance with Cherif Boubaghla. She led many battles and won the respect of her people. In 1857, the French soldiers arrested her. She died in prison in 1863. Today, Algerians remember her as a great heroine.

(Text written by the site)

A. Reading comprehension (8 points)

1. True or false? a) Fatma N'Soumer was born in 1830. b) She fought alone. c) She died in 1857.

2. Answer: a) Where was she born? b) What happened in 1857?

3. Put the events in order: she died in prison — she was born — she led battles — the French arrested her.

B. Mastery of language (6 points)

1. Give the past simple of: to be → … ; to lead → … ; to win → … ; to learn → …

2. Ask questions about the underlined words: She died in 1863. — She organised the resistance with Cherif Boubaghla.

3. Classify according to the pronunciation of "-ed": attacked – organised – arrested.

C. Written expression (6 points)

Write a short biography (6 lines) of a famous Algerian person of your choice. Use the past simple and dates.
